card.name: The word "to" after Inability
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "Inability" in contraindication lists, mainly "Inability to stand or sit upright". Also modal words like "will" or "can" after "patients who".

modes.label: Inability to
modes.description: The word "to" directly after "Inability" in a contraindication list.
modes.example: • Inability<< to>> stand or sit upright for at least

modes.label: Patients who can/will
modes.description: A modal verb after "patients who" describing the patient's required ability.
modes.example: SYMLIN should be used only in patients who<< can>> fully understand and adhere to proper insulin adjustments

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about ability or being able to do something.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that follows "inability" or "patients who can", where the text is about a patient's capacity to do something.
